anomaly_types_detectable: Data Exfiltration — abnormally large Response Bytes (Bwd Pkt Len Max/Min)
Brute Force / Scraping — very high Flow Bytes/s with small request size
Slowloris / DoS — extremely high Flow Duration with small byte counts
Abnormal Request Volume — spike in Total Fwd Packets

feature_mapping.Flow Duration: Labrooms slot [1] — total HTTP request processing time (microseconds)
feature_mapping.Total Fwd Packets: Labrooms slot [2] — represents the incoming HTTP Request (always 1)
feature_mapping.Total Length of Fwd Packets: Labrooms slot [4] — size of the incoming HTTP request (bytes)
feature_mapping.Fwd Packet Length Max: Labrooms slot [6] — same as Total Fwd Bytes (request size)
feature_mapping.Fwd Packet Length Min: Labrooms slot [7] — same as Total Fwd Bytes (request size)
feature_mapping.Bwd Packet Length Max: Labrooms slot [5] — total HTTP response bytes used as a packet-length proxy
feature_mapping.Bwd Packet Length Min: Labrooms slot [5] — same response-byte proxy; Labrooms reports one response flow

omitted_labrooms_slots.[0] Flow ID Hash: Omitted — numeric identifier, not a learnable ML feature
omitted_labrooms_slots.[3] Total Bwd Packets: Omitted — response count is not a backward packet-length measurement
omitted_labrooms_slots.[44] HTTP Status Code: Omitted — no equivalent in CICIDS2017; use if future dataset provides it

zeroed_feature_groups: The following CICIDS2017 feature groups are always zero in Labrooms deployments and MUST NOT be used during training to avoid training-serving skew: Packet-level length stats (Fwd/Bwd Mean/Std), Inter-Arrival Times (IAT), TCP Flags (FIN/RST/PSH/ACK/URG/SYN), Header Lengths, Global Packet Stats, Window sizes, Subflow stats, Active/Idle stats.
notes: Model trained with this contract detects application-layer anomalies rather than network-layer anomalies. TCP-flag-based attacks (e.g. SYN Floods) cannot be detected because those features are always zero in Labrooms. Focus instead on flow size, duration, and throughput anomalies.
